column1: # The blocking gate's selections (dev/block.jl, `bash dev/gate.sh --block`; L194), measured in full
# on b85da40f by test/block_impact.jl from the lines of src/ each probe, each smoke group and each
# QA family a lock cites as behavior runs, cut into 40-line pieces of each top-level definition,
# each line of a `const` table its own (225 probes run 1195 pieces of src/, 41 cover them; 106 smoke
# groups run 1536, the core's 11 groups (86 cases, 29.4 s recorded) run 1274; the 17 cited QA
# families run 1465). `probes`: the probe core, a cover of every piece any probe runs; the gate adds
# the probes a change touches in test/probe_corpus.jl or test/probe_baseline.txt. `core`: the smoke
# core every landing runs, the cover by pieces per recorded second (test/smoke_times.tsv) up to 30
# s; the first group pays for compiling the compiler. `<file><TAB><groups><TAB><QA
# families><TAB><1.13 groups>`: a changed file's groups beyond the core, the cover (up to 25 s) of
# its pieces some group runs and the core does not, then the QA families the gate's tests stage runs
# for it, the cover (up to 20 s of test/phase_times.tsv's seconds) of its pieces run by the QA
# families its locks cite as behavior (the locks reading it by path; a family past 20 s on its own
# runs on the full matrix only), then the smoke groups the gate runs on Julia 1.13 when the file
# changes (set by hand for a file whose output prints Julia's own signatures or types, which differ
# between versions: the export namer, trimcollect.jl's show_spec_sig); `-` for none (a directory
# row, ending in /, covers its files; the longest match wins). A changed file under src/ or ext/, or
# a changed test file no stage runs and no QA family is, with no row fails the gate: a batch that
# adds a file adds its row, re-recorded or, when unsure, naming more. `matrix-only`: groups no stage
# here runs, even when the change touches them or a row names them: test/registry_cases.jl's
# generated groups, whose blocking sample is its registry_sample group (Amendment 117-14: split,
# never exempt), and entered_paths, which exists for a matrix-only check (the emission-diff check's
# Base paths, L190). Every probe, group and QA family still runs on every landed head (non-blocking:
# gate.yml on march/**). `measured`: the src tree measured; a change to src/ fails the gate when
# more than 8 pieces of src (dev/block.jl STALE_PIECES) changed between it and the change's base,
# when this repository does not hold it, or when a changed line of code lies in no piece, and a
# change to ext/, which no map measures, fails (A20C13): the re-record runs off the landing path and
# lands as its own commit of this file. What the selection cannot see, A19C1's (a)-(g) (A20C14),
# each OPEN: (a) overlay and bespoke bodies, (b) a top-level form other than a definition, (c) two
# methods of one name and (f) the universe are open until the gate runs every case whose plan
# compiles a changed body, read from the plan's record (dev/AUDIT.md A24S1: a staleness count closes
# none of them); meanwhile the rows below count a body a plan compiles as run by its case
# (test/block_impact.jl planned_lines) and key every form, a table's every line and each definition
# by its line (dev/block.jl line_keys), the QA families a lock cites run (d5b96e97) and a stale map
# and ext/ fail the gate, while the stdlib and fuzz lanes run on the matrix alone; (d) a changed
# branch inside a 40-line piece some case runs, open; (e) a 1-cover, one runner per piece, open; (g)
# the 1.13 core on every src change, open (MARCH 13.17). The measurement ran each cited QA family in
# a module of its own, BlockImpactQA (test/block_impact.jl run_qa), and three failed tests there
# that read names as Main's, none with an error: generated_names.jl (8 of 19),
# dispatch_method_error.jl (1 of 93), real_bottom_exceptions.jl (1 of 22); the src lines they ran
# count, since a failed assertion stops no testset. overlay_reasons.jl runs no line of src/ (it
# reads ext/ and Julia's own typed IR) and covers no piece. A family failing under the harness is
# open: the measurement should run each family as its shard runs it.
# An incremental re-record (test/block_impact.jl --pieces, from the sets the last measurement saved)
# measures again only the probes, groups and QA families whose saved lines touch a src file that
# moved, keeps this header and moves the `measured` row; it cannot see an unchanged call that a new
# method sends into a changed file, or an entry whose own test definition changed under the same
# name: a full re-record measures a fresh map.
